text: つきの　いしね…　そこらへんの　いしころと　どこが　ちがうんだろう？

structure.jp: そこらへんの　いしころと
structure.en: from any old rock lying around

structure.jp: どこが　ちがうんだろう？
structure.en: where is it different, I wonder?

patterns.name: 〜とちがう
patterns.span: いしころと　どこが　ちがう
patterns.explanation: と before ちがう shows the thing something is different from. いしころと　どこが　ちがう = 'in what way is it different from a rock'.

patterns.name: 〜んだろう
patterns.explanation: んだろう after a question word is the speaker wondering aloud. どこが　ちがうんだろう = 'I wonder how it's different'.
